name: cell_cycle
description: Cell-cycle/proliferation auxiliary programs for flag-only scoring.

name: fibrosis
description: Fibrosis and stromal remodeling auxiliary programs.

name: immune_lymphoid_states
description: Lymphoid immune subtype/state programs for lymphoma-context flag-only annotation. These do not establish malignant status by themselves.

name: inflammation
description: Inflammatory and antigen-presentation auxiliary programs for flag-only scoring.

name: stress
description: Stress, hypoxia, interferon, and UPR auxiliary programs for flag-only scoring.

name: tumor_breast
description: Breast-focused tumor-state marker programs, plus tumor_general by default.

name: tumor_colon
description: Colon-focused tumor-state marker programs, plus tumor_general by default.

name: tumor_general
description: Shared solid-tumor status, state, and modifier programs. Status programs establish tumor-like support; state/modifier programs add context.

name: tumor_skin
description: Skin-focused tumor-state programs: reusable squamous states plus melanocytic state descriptors, with tumor_general added by default.

name: tumor_squamous
description: Reusable squamous tumor-state programs. These decorate solid-tumor calls after squamous lineage is established by the normal hierarchy.

name: tumor_tonsil
description: Tonsil/oropharynx squamous tumor-state programs, plus tumor_general by default.
